body: Install the latest Doré Design v1 runtime from origin/main on the Mac mini, repair any local runtime or permission defect causing published pages to appear grey/unselectable, restart the live editor on 127.0.0.1:4310, then verify both page activation and editor-generated HTML preview/export for New Westside · Watchtower Fold. Do not report PASS unless the live runtime is actually serving version 1.0 and the Watchtower page is present.

argv: mkdir -p ~/.dore/design-runtime ~/.dore/design; chmod u+rwx ~/.dore ~/.dore/design ~/.dore/design-runtime; git show origin/main:dore-design/app.py > ~/.dore/design-runtime/app.py; git show origin/main:dore-design/app_workspace.py > ~/.dore/design-runtime/app_workspace.py; git show origin/main:dore-design/app_product.py > ~/.dore/design-runtime/app_product.py; chmod u+rw ~/.dore/design-runtime/*.py; test -r ~/.dore/design/westside-watch.workspace.json && chmod u+rw ~/.dore/design/westside-watch.workspace.json || true; python3 -m py_compile ~/.dore/design-runtime/app.py ~/.dore/design-runtime/app_workspace.py ~/.dore/design-runtime/app_product.py
pkill -f 'app_product.py' || true; sleep 1; cd ~/.dore/design-runtime && nohup python3 app_product.py > ~/.dore/design/editor.log 2>&1 &

sleep 2; python3 - <<'PY'
import json,urllib.request
base='http://127.0.0.1:4310'
h=json.loads(urllib.request.urlopen(base+'/api/health',timeout=5).read().decode())
assert h.get('version')=='1.0',h
assert h.get('page_activation_fix') is True,h
assert h.get('html_preview') is True and h.get('html_export') is True,h
html=urllib.request.urlopen(base+'/',timeout=5).read().decode()
for marker in ['DORÉ DESIGN 1.0','data-page-id','HTML Preview','HTML Export','activatePage']:
    assert marker in html,marker
w=json.loads(urllib.request.urlopen(base+'/api/workspace',timeout=5).read().decode())
p=next((x for x in w.get('pages',[]) if x.get('id')=='new-westside-watchtower-fold'),None)
assert p and p.get('name')=='New Westside · Watchtower Fold',p
preview=urllib.request.urlopen(base+'/preview/new-westside-watchtower-fold',timeout=5).read().decode()
exported=urllib.request.urlopen(base+'/api/export.html?page=new-westside-watchtower-fold',timeout=5).read().decode()
for doc in [preview,exported]:
    assert '<!doctype html>' in doc.lower()
    assert 'WATCH' in doc and 'DAWN' in doc
    assert '守望黎明' in doc
print(json.dumps({'ok':True,'code':'DORE_DESIGN_V1_EDITOR_HTML_PIPELINE_LIVE_PASS','health':h,'workspace_revision':w.get('revision'),'page_id':p['id'],'page_name':p['name'],'preview_bytes':len(preview),'export_bytes':len(exported)},ensure_ascii=False))
PY
